title: Flavio Pineda
text:
I am a theoretical physicist specializing in Early Universe Cosmology and Inflation. My research focuses on the intersection of Quantum Field Theory (QFT) and gravity, specifically exploring the Higgs-\(R^2\) inflation model.
Currently, I am working on: * Non-Gaussianities: Calculating primordial fluctuations in multi-field models. * Particle Production: Understanding reheating and gravitational effects. * Software: Developing primordialpy, a Python library for cosmological calculations.
I bridge the gap between complex theoretical frameworks and computational implementation.
